cases.text: My 60 year old male grandfather is having a 104 degree fever

assessment.advice: See a doctor today. Go to emergency if it gets worse.

cases.text: my hands are paining, i am sweating all night, and im coughing up blood, i dont know what it is. might be a bad spoiled lunch i had 5 days ago

assessment.advice: Go to the emergency department now, or call an ambulance (112 / 108 in India, 911 in the US).
reasons: vomiting or coughing blood (“coughing up blood”)

cases.text: my 2 year old has a 105 degree fever and is having rashes in his arm, he is coughing heavily and is unable to breath properly

assessment.advice: Go to the emergency department now, or call an ambulance (112 / 108 in India, 911 in the US).
other_reasons: high temperature in a child under 3
